response:
I am so sorry you experienced such profound deception and abuse. It is completely understandable that you are struggling to trust again. When someone manipulates your emotions and uses intimidation, it deeply fractures your sense of safety. Your hyper-vigilance right now is a natural protective response to severe betrayal. Please know that the abuse you endured is not your fault. If you ever feel unsafe due to her intimidation, please reach out to local authorities or a domestic abuse hotline.

Rebuilding trust takes time, and it is okay to take things slowly. You do not have to force new connections before you are ready. Healing often begins by focusing on trusting yourself again and setting firm boundaries. Because you have been through severe emotional abuse, speaking with a trauma-informed therapist could be incredibly helpful. They can support you in processing this betrayal and safely navigating the lingering effects of her control, helping you eventually open up to healthy connections.
